_why_locale_catalogs_not_all_caps: The real archive's own paths (7z against BoingBag39-2-turkce.lha) are
lower-case: `locale/catalogs/türkçe/*.catalog` — matched here on `from`
exactly as measured. `to` is written mixed-case, `Locale/Catalogs`,
matching the AmigaDOS convention every other component in every shipped
recipe already uses for a destination it writes (`Locale/Countries`,
`Locale/Languages`, `Locale/Help` in the 3.2 recipe, and now
`amigaos-3.9.json`'s own `locale-base` component too — ART-162, added in
the same review round that corrected this note) — never the all-caps
spelling a Joliet-less disc's own Primary tree happens to force on a
`from`. AmigaDOS resolves a path case-insensitively, so the *spelling*
cannot collide with anything.
**Correction (Task 4 review, fix round 1):** the sentence that stood here
originally — 'nothing in the shipped AmigaOS 3.9 recipe writes a Locale
drawer of its own yet' — was wrong about the disc, not just about this
recipe: `OS-Version3.9/Locale` is a real top-level drawer on the CD
(Catalogs, Countries, Flags, Help, Languages, Providers), and
`amigaos-3.9.json`'s new `locale-base` component now places four of those
six, including `Locale/Catalogs`. So this package's destination is not a
forward-looking convention choice any more — it is the *same* directory
`locale-base` already populates, and the two do collide for real: the
base disc's own `OS-Version3.9/Locale/Catalogs/türkçe` already carries
roughly the same ~34 catalog names this package updates (measured, 7z
against `AmigaOS39.iso`). Left uncorrected, `overrides` would again be
declaring nothing about a real, measured fact — the F1 mistake repeated a
second time in the same commit — so `locale-base` is declared below.

_why_requires_components_locale_base: ART-162, arriving through the selection instead of through the recipe.
This package writes ~36 catalogs into `Locale/Catalogs`. Without
`locale-base` switched on, nothing on the volume puts `Locale/Languages`
or the locale preferences there, so those catalogs sit in a drawer no
running system can open — a silent no-op dressed up as a successful
install. `requires` cannot say this: it relates packages to packages,
and `locale-base` is a release recipe's component (it exists under that
id in both `amigaos-3.9.json` and `amigaos-3.2.json`), so naming it
there would refuse a correct selection by name. `plan()` refuses the
combination instead — see `package.rs`'s own module doc comment.
